description: Brainstorm business names by industry — prefix + suffix combos with industry keywords and an optional domain-style version.

faqs.a: Each result pairs a brandable prefix with a suffix (like Labs or Studio) plus an industry keyword (like Cloud for tech).
Tick the domain-style option to see a lowercase no-space version with a random TLD, e.g. novacloud.io.
Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Tick domain-style if you want a web-ready version.
Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.
title: Business Name Generator
